description:
Update your flashcard generation preferences. Requires authentication. Set reset_to_default=true to restore all defaults.

**Settings:**
- language: Any language code (e.g., "en", "es", "ja")
- cards_per_unit_min/max: Card count range (4-7)
- card_styles: Teaching persona array (e.g., ["supportive tutor"], ["professor"], ["study buddy"])
- image_theme: Any art style (e.g., "vibrant educational", "anime", "minimal", "watercolor")
- image_source: "ai" (AI-generated images) or "stock" (stock images), default "ai"

**Defaults:** en, 4-7 cards, supportive tutor persona, vibrant educational theme, AI images
FREE (no coin cost).
name: change_flashcard_settings
title: Change Flashcard Settings
